project_type: Node.js movie booking web application (backend API + frontend SPA)
build_system: None - zero external dependencies, uses Node.js built-in http module
test_framework: None currently - will use Node.js built-in test runner (node --test)
build_command: No build step needed - vanilla JS
test_command: unset NODE_OPTIONS && node server.js & sleep 2 && node test.js; kill %1
verification_instructions: 1. Run `unset NODE_OPTIONS && node server.js` to start server. 2. Visit http://localhost:3000 in browser. 3. Verify mobile-first UI loads with purple theme. 4. Check all 5 bottom nav tabs work. 5. Test booking flow end-to-end.
setup_instructions: No setup needed - zero external dependencies. Just run `node server.js`.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - cannot install npm packages from registry. Must use Node.js built-in modules only (http, fs, path, url, crypto). Cannot load external CDN resources. All CSS/JS must be inline or served locally. Node.js v22 available.
contribution_requirements: Commit to main branch in the Cluade repository. Project goes in movie-booking/ directory.
key_patterns: Existing branch feature/movie-booking-system has an Express-based implementation. We are rebuilding from scratch with zero dependencies, mobile-first purple UI, and 5-tab navigation matching user's design specs.
directory_structure: movie-booking/ is the project root containing: server.js (main entry), public/ (static HTML/CSS/JS files), data/ (JSON file-based storage), README.md, package.json
